about_the_game:
In a universe where tennis is powered by screaming, you must yell louder than the rest if you want to be crowned the ultimate noisemaker—or even a tennis player. So go ahead, scream at your friends in PvP mode, or yell at an AI-driven robot in PvA. Because there's no way to enjoy a tennis match if you don't at least shout a little.

HOW IT WORKS

In OH TENNIS, your voice is your racket. You aim your shots with the mouse, move around the court using WASD, and yell into your microphone to strike the ball. The louder you shout, the more powerful your hit. Mastering your vocal control is key—if you manage to hit within the golden zone of the voice meter, you'll land a perfect shot.

SIMPLIFIED SPACE TENNIS RULES

Once the match starts, forget everything you know about traditional tennis. After the serve, the ball doesn’t need to bounce you can hit it mid-air. The entire court counts as a valid hit zone, just like in doubles matches. Win two sets and the match is yours. And if the score reaches 40/40, it all comes down to whoever scores two consecutive points first.

GAME MODES

Whether you want to compete with friends or scream at bots, OH TENNIS has you covered. Jump into chaotic online PvP matches and battle others in full-volume duels, or test your skills against AI opponents equipped with unique voice packs and quirky personalities. Need to warm up? Practice Mode lets you fine-tune your voice-powered shots before going full tilt.

CUSTOMIZATION & ACHIEVEMENTS

Progress through the game to earn achievements based on your performance, your volume, or just how ridiculous your shots are. From perfect smashes to the loudest outbursts, you’ll be rewarded for both skill and silliness.

FINAL SERVE

OH TENNIS is a fast-paced, party-fueled, intergalactic shouting contest disguised as a tennis game. Whether you're chasing victory or simply trying to out-yell your friends, this is tennis like you've never screamed it before.

JOIN THE COMMUNITY

Join our official Discord server to connect with other players, suggest new ideas, report bugs, or just yell into the void with people who get it.
